## How we package work

Under one positioning, engagement size can flex:

1. **Custom software** — websites, apps, CRMs, booking tools, project builds (e.g. ~$5,000+ engagements)
2. **AI automation** — receptionists, lead follow-up, content agents, workflow automation
3. **Modern technology solutions** — integrations, analytics, SaaS rebuilds, larger implementations
4. **Growth packages** — Starter Social $149/mo · Social Growth $299/mo · Facebook Ads + Social $499/mo (ad spend separate)

## Industries

Insurance brokers, real estate agents, accounting firms, medical offices, law firms, retail and service businesses.
